The Warp Disciple is a crew mask who shows their eternal devotion to the warp drive receives undivine favor in the form of a recall. All they care about is that the warp drive is clean of any corruption, protective even.
If the end phase calls for somebody to be sacrificed, they will volunteer themselves.
They must be the one that unclogs the warp drive by picking up the garbage inside its realm, nobody else.
